title: Gina kasafin kuɗi wanda ke aiki, kuma yana lanƙwasa cikin watanni masu wahala

say: Gina kasafin kuɗi wanda ke aiki, kuma yana lanƙwasa cikin watanni masu wahala.
Wannan shine bidiyon na Module 3, Kasafin Kudi: Tsara Kuɗin ku Watan Wata.
Kasafin kuɗi shiri ne na kuɗin ku, wanda aka yi kafin ku kashe shi. Wannan da yawa yana shigowa, kuma nan ne ainihin inda zai shiga.

panel.kicker: Me ya sa wannan ya shafi

say: Bin diddigi ya waiwayi abin da ya faru. Kasafin kudi na sa ido. Tare suna samar da madauki: tsari, ciyarwa, waƙa, kwatanta, haɓakawa.

say: Kasafin kudi ba hukunci bane ko alamar cewa kai talaka ne. Yana nufin ka yanke shawara a gaba, cikin nutsuwa, maimakon kasuwa ko lokacin da dangi ya kira.

say: Shahararriyar jagora ita ce kashi 50 na buƙatu, kashi 30 don buƙatu, da kashi 20 don tanadi.
Misali Zainab wata ma’aikaciyar jinya a Abuja tana daukar kimanin naira 250,000 gida duk wata. Rarraba classic yana ba da bukatu 125,000, yana son 75,000 da tanadi 50,000.
Amma ainihin bukatunta, gami da maganin mahaifiyarta, kusan 175,000 ne. Wannan kashi 70 ne, kuma wannan ba gazawa ba ne.
Don haka ta yanke so 25,000 kuma ta ajiye ajiyar kuɗi a 50,000. Tana kare ajiyarta ta hanyar gyara buƙatun, ba wai ta nuna cewa buƙatunta sun yi ƙanƙanta ba.
Rubuta kudin shiga da ake tsammani a saman. Yi amfani da biyan kuɗin gida, ko amintaccen adadi idan kuɗin shiga bai saba ba. Sannan rubuta tanadi tukuna.

panel.heading: Cika kasafin ku a wannan tsari

say: Sannan kafaffen bukatu. Juya farashin shekara kamar haya zuwa layin wata-wata, don haka kuɗin yana jira lokacin da ranar haya ta zo.

panel.heading: Cika kasafin ku a wannan tsari

say: Sannan buƙatu masu canzawa, ta amfani da bin diddigin ku azaman jagora.

panel.heading: Cika kasafin ku a wannan tsari

say: Sannan layin bayar da gaskiya na coci ko masallaci, dangi da abubuwan da suka faru. Abubuwan so yakamata su kasance masu matsakaici amma ba sifili ba. Kuma ƙara ma'auni na kusan kashi 5 don abubuwan da kuka manta.

panel.heading: Cika kasafin ku a wannan tsari

say: Idan jimillar ya fi kudin shiga, yanke so da farko, sannan a datse buƙatun masu canji. Idan har yanzu bai daidaita ba, samun kudin shiga na iya buƙatar tashi.
Kada ku rance don bukatun yau da kullum. Wannan kawai yana motsa matsalar zuwa wata mai zuwa, tare da ƙarin sha'awa.

panel.heading: Cika kasafin ku a wannan tsari
panel.rule: Kar a taɓa daidaita kasafin kuɗi ta hanyar rance don buƙatun yau da kullun.

say: Misali, Tolu da mijinta a Legas suna daukar kusan naira 400,000 gida a wata.

card.title: Kasafin kudin dangin Tolu a Legas

say: Ajiye yana farawa: 30,000 don asusun gaggawa da 30,000 don kuɗin makaranta.

card.title: Kasafin kudin dangin Tolu a Legas

say: Kudin hayarsu na shekara kusan naira miliyan daya da dubu dari biyu. An raba shi da 12, wato 100,000 a wata a cikin tukunyar haya, da 10,000 na haɗin gwiwar.

card.title: Kasafin kudin dangin Tolu a Legas

say: Abinci, sufuri, wutar lantarki, gas, bayanai da kayan bayan gida sun kai 186,000. Abinci shine layin mafi girma, don haka menu na mako-mako da manyan ma'auni suna yin babban bambanci.

card.title: Kasafin kudin dangin Tolu a Legas

say: Bayarwa shine 20,000, buffer 10,000, kuma yana son samun 14,000.

card.title: Kasafin kudin dangin Tolu a Legas

say: Ya kai Naira 400,000 daidai. Ana kiyaye tanadi da haya da farko, kuma yana son samun abin da ya rage a zahiri.

card.title: Kasafin kudin dangin Tolu a Legas

say: A ranar biya, fara matsar da tanadi, ajiyar haya da ajiyar kuɗin makaranta cikin tukwanensu da farko.

say: Raba abinci da sufuri zuwa adadin mako-mako. Idan abinci ya kai Naira 80,000 a wata, sai ka ba wa kanka kusan 20,000 kowane mako. Yawan kashe kuɗi yana nunawa a cikin mako ɗaya, yayin da sauran lokaci.

say: Sannan ku ciyar da mintuna 10 kowane mako rubuta ainihin kashe kuɗi kusa da shirin. Misali, Ese a birnin Benin an kashe naira 6,000 akan abinci. Ta kwashe 3,000 daga sufuri da 3,000 daga buƙatun, kuma kuɗin da ta samu bai taɓa faruwa ba.

say: Kyakkyawan kasafin kuɗi yana lanƙwasa ba tare da karye ba. Kare abinci, matsuguni da lafiya da farko, sannan farashin da ke ci gaba da zuwa. Yanke so farko.
Misali, Ngozi tana sayar da tufafi a Onitsha. Kullum tana shirin kusan naira 150,000, amma tana tsammanin 110,000 kacal a wannan watan. Ta yanke buƙatun, ta tanadi 12,000.

panel.heading: Ngozi ta rufe gibin naira 40,000
items: Abincin da aka gyara ta hanyar siyan yawa: yana adana 6,000
An rage tanadin manufa: yana ajiye 15,000

say: Ta rage bayarwa kuma ta bayyana wa dangi cewa wannan wata ne mai tauri. Wannan yana adana 7,000.

panel.heading: Ngozi ta rufe gibin naira 40,000
items: Abincin da aka gyara ta hanyar siyan yawa: yana adana 6,000
An rage tanadin manufa: yana ajiye 15,000

say: Tana girki da yawa kuma tana siyan kayan abinci da makwabciyarta, ta tanadi abinci 6,000.

panel.heading: Ngozi ta rufe gibin naira 40,000

An rage tanadin manufa: yana ajiye 15,000

say: Ta rage tanadin burinta da 15,000, amma ta ci gaba da biyan kuɗin hayar gaba ɗaya. Tare wanda ke rufe gibin 40,000 ba tare da aro ba.

say: Kunna faɗakarwar ciniki. Kada ku taɓa raba PIN, kalmar sirri, OTP ko BVN ga kowa, gami da wanda ya ce daga bankin ku yake.

Zamba na amfani da saƙonnin gaggawa, wani lokaci daga asusun abokai da aka yi kutse. Yana da kyau a ce za ku duba kasafin ku kuma ku ba da amsa da yamma. Kuma guje wa lamuni mai sauri don abincin yau da kullun da lissafin kuɗi.
